name: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd
about: Motherson Sumi Wiring India, a JV between Sumitomo Wiring System and Motherson Group, is a market leader in the Indian wiring harness industry with a market share of over 40%.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile:[1] MSWIL was formed in April 2021, when Samvardhana Motherson International Limited (SAMIL) demerged its wiring harness business for Indian OEMs into a separate company. It is a JV with Sumitomo Wiring Systems, Ltd., a global leader in wiring harnesses, harness components and electrical wiring.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 36.5%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 47.5%
cons: Stock is trading at 12.9 times its book value
Debtor days have increased from 49.3 to 59.9 days.
